Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026

1. Introduction

SLV Bakery values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it when you use our website or mobile application.

By using our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

2. Information We Collect

To provide our services effectively, we may collect information such as your name, phone number, email address, delivery address, city, state, pincode, and order details.

We may also collect information about your interactions with our website or application, such as products viewed, products added to your cart, orders placed, and other activity necessary to provide our services.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to process and deliver your orders, communicate with you about your order, provide customer support, and maintain your account.

Your information may also be used to improve our products, services, website functionality, and overall customer experience.

4. Order & Delivery Information

Your delivery information is required to successfully prepare and deliver your order. This may include your name, phone number, address, city, state, and pincode.

We may use your phone number or email address to provide important updates regarding your order, including order confirmation, preparation, delivery, cancellation, and support-related communication.

5. Payment Information

Payments may be processed through authorized payment service providers. SLV Bakery does not intentionally store sensitive payment information such as complete card numbers or banking credentials on its own servers.

Payment providers may process information according to their own privacy policies and security practices.

6. Cookies & Similar Technologies

Our website or application may use cookies, local storage, or similar technologies to maintain login sessions, remember preferences, improve functionality, and provide a better browsing experience.

You may be able to control certain cookie settings through your browser or device settings.

7. Sharing of Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. Your information may only be shared when reasonably necessary to provide our services.

This may include sharing relevant information with delivery personnel, payment service providers, technology providers, or other service providers involved in fulfilling your order.

Information may also be disclosed when required by applicable law, regulation, court order, or government authority.

8. Data Security

SLV Bakery takes reasonable measures to protect customer information from unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

However, no online service or method of electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Customers should also take appropriate steps to protect their account credentials.

9. Account Security

If you create an account with SLV Bakery, you are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity performed through your account.

If you believe that your account has been accessed without authorization, please contact us as soon as possible.

10. Data Retention

We retain customer information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, maintain order records, provide customer support, resolve disputes, and meet applicable legal or business requirements.

When information is no longer required, it may be deleted or securely disposed of in accordance with applicable requirements.

11. Children's Privacy

Our services are not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate consent. If we learn that personal information has been collected from a child improperly, we will take reasonable steps to address the situation.

12. Your Privacy Choices

Depending on applicable laws and circumstances, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including requesting access to, correction of, or deletion of certain information.

To make a privacy-related request, please contact SLV Bakery using the contact information provided on our website.

13. Third-Party Services

Our website or application may use third-party services for payments, authentication, analytics, hosting, delivery, or other technical functions.

These providers may process information according to their own privacy policies. We recommend reviewing their respective policies when using their services.

14. Changes to This Privacy Policy

SLV Bakery may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology, legal requirements, or privacy practices.

Any updated version will be published on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.

15. Contact Us

If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the way your information is handled, please contact SLV Bakery through the contact details provided on our website.

Your privacy matters to us.

Thank you for trusting SLV Bakery with your information. We are committed to handling your information responsibly and providing a safe and convenient ordering experience.
